    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def ranges(seps,n):
    out=[];start=0
    for s in seps+[n]:
        if s-start>1: out.append(list(range(start,s)))
        start=s+1
    return out
def f(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); v=4
    sep_rows=[i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==v for j in range(W))]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==v for i in range(H))]

import os,re,collections,json
def load():

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def ranges(seps,n):
    out=[];start=0
    for s in seps+[n]:
        if s-start>1: out.append(list(range(start,s))); start=s+1
    return out

    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); v=None
    for vv in set(sum(g,[])):
        if any(all(g[i][j]==vv for j in range(W)) for i in range(H)) or any(all(g[i][j]==vv for i in range(H)) for j in range(W)):

    sr=[i for i in range(H) if all(g[i][j]==v for j in range(W))]
    sc=[j for j in range(W) if all(g[i][j]==v for i in range(H))]
    rng_r=ranges(sr,H); rng_c=ranges(sc,W)
    bg=collections.Counter(x for r_ in g for x in r_).most_common(1)[0][0]

    for ra in rng_r:
